market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Republican Susan Collins is heavily favored to retain her seat. She has a history of ticket-splitting support, won by 8.6 points in 2020 despite Biden winning Maine by 9. Even if she retires (low probability), an open seat is not as hopeless as a 22.5% implied chance suggests. The market seems to dramatically misprice the true likelihood of a GOP hold.
evidence_points: Susan Collins has not indicated retirement and remains popular, outperforming the Republican presidential ticket.
Maine voters have a strong history of re-electing moderate incumbents; Collins won in 2020 in a Biden +9 state.
Early ratings for this seat are not yet competitive; no credible challenger has emerged, and the seat is widely seen as Safe/Likely Republican.
sources_consulted: Cook Political Report / Inside Elections early outlooks for 2026 Senate races (anecdotal consensus)
